summary: The blueprint broadly covers human pancreas cell types but needs targeted refinement for mural-cell and dendritic-cell resolution plus a few marker-specificity issues.

issues.description: The mural module merges pericyte markers with vascular smooth muscle markers, so the embedding cannot separate two expected human pancreas stromal populations.
issues.suggested_fix: Split mural representation into pericyte and vascular smooth-muscle modules/axes, or keep a mural core and add gated subtype axes using pericyte markers such as RGS5, PDGFRB, CSPG4, NOTCH3, ABCC9, KCNJ8 versus smooth-muscle markers such as ACTA2, TAGLN, MYH11, CNN1, MYL9, TPM2.

issues.description: The dendritic module combines cDC2, cDC1, and pDC-associated markers into one axis, under-resolving expected antigen-presenting immune subsets for an all-cell pancreas embedding.
issues.suggested_fix: Either rename/reshape this as a broad dendritic/APC axis and add cDC1, cDC2, and pDC gated immune subaxes, or split the current module into separate dendritic subtype modules with sibling negative modules under immune_core.

issues.description: B2M is broadly expressed across nucleated human cells and weakens leukocyte specificity in a pan-immune module; CXCR4 is also broad but less severe.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove B2M from immune_core and replace it with a more leukocyte-enriched immune atlas-supported marker such as CD53 or LAPTM5 while retaining PTPRC, LCP1, and CORO1A-type genes.

issues.description: The epsilon module has one highly specific marker, GHRL, plus broad endocrine/prohormone genes shared with other endocrine modules, so the axis may be noisy for rare ghrelin-positive epsilon cells.
issues.suggested_fix: If supported by the cited human pancreas literature, add additional ghrelin-cell markers and reduce reliance on CHGA, CHGB, PCSK1, and PCSK2; otherwise keep the axis but make it explicitly GHRL-centered rather than equally resolved with major endocrine subtypes.

out_of_scope: Citation DOI verification was not performed because it is outside the discriminator scope; python3 embedder_blueprint.py --describe succeeded.
